summary: Example of fail used with when to abort if a CMDB status variable isn't 'to-be-staged'.
questions: How do I abort a play if a host isn't in the right state?
How do I combine fail and when?

answer_card.title: fail example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.fail:
    msg: The system may not be provisioned according to the CMDB status.
  when: cmdb_status != "to-be-staged"
```
